name: SS8050
description: NPN medium-power transistor (1.5A) in TO-92, a high-current jellybean for audio output and switching. TO-92 pin order is E-B-C, the reverse of European BC-series. Complement to the PNP SS8550.

pins.name: E
pins.description: emitter (leftmost lead, flat face toward you)

TO-92.notes: flat face toward you, leads down: E-B-C left to right. Verified from Fairchild/onsemi SS8050 datasheet (1=E, 2=B, 3=C). Order flips to C-B-E only if you view the rounded back.

typical_application: ~2W output amplifier for portable radios (Class B push-pull), general medium-power switching and small load driving.
gotchas: pinout is E-B-C (pin 1 = emitter on the left), NOT the C-B-E people often assume for a TO-92; this is the most common mistake on this part
the SMD S8050 in SOT-23 has a different JEDEC pin map; this entry is the TO-92 only
1.5A rating but only 1W dissipation; high current needs low Vce
